text: ポケモンが　つかう　わざは　げんざい　わかって　いるだけで　３５０しゅるい　いじょうある

structure.jp: ポケモンが　つかう　わざは
げんざい　わかって　いるだけで
３５０しゅるい　いじょうある

patterns.name: 〜だけで
patterns.span: わかって　いるだけで
patterns.explanation: だけで after a phrase means 'with only that much counted'. わかって　いるだけで = 'just among the ones that are known'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　つかう　わざ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which one. ポケモンが　つかう　わざ = 'the moves that Pokémon use'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows a state that holds now, after something became so. わかって　いる = 'are known'.
